# StockFlow Pro POS & ERP

> Fast, resilient Point of Sale (POS) and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform tailored for retail, grocery stores, and micro-enterprises.

## Core Capabilities
- **High-Velocity POS Terminal**: Barcode scanning, multi-method tender (Cash, Card, MFS / bKash / Nagad), instant thermal receipt generation (80mm/58mm format).
- **Dual-Mode Sync & Offline Resilience**: In-memory and IndexedDB local cart cache with optimistic checkouts and background retry queues.
- **Baki Khata (Customer Credit Ledger)**: Account-level receivable management, credit limit validation, and incremental debt repayment collection.
- **Real-Time Inventory & Stock Adjustments**: Multi-category product tracking, SKU/barcode lookup, cost and profit margin analysis, and granular audit trail logging.
- **Financial Analytics & P&L Statements**: Automated Gross Margin, Operating Expense categorization, and Net Profit calculations.
- **Enterprise Security**: Sanctum token authentication, rate-limiting on sensitive endpoints, secure HTTP headers, and strict SQL parameterization.

## Architecture
- **Backend**: Laravel 11/13 REST API with SQLite / MySQL dual compatibility, Eloquent ORM, and database transaction locking.
- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, decoupled modular architecture.
- **API Spec**: Standardized JSON responses with status codes, validation error bags, and metadata pagination.
